title: hand-decomposed softmax (REDUCE_MAX/EXP/SUM/DIV) -> builtin SOFTMAX

rewrite.equivalence_evidence: same max-subtracted formulation; probe outputs max_abs_diff 1.4e-06

scope: synthetic attention probe; softmax rows length 1024
notes: The converter re-fuses the plain exp/sum/div pattern back into SOFTMAX; the probe had to use a reciprocal-mul form to stay decomposed. Conversions that keep softmax decomposed (e.g. for masking tricks) pay 2x on the NPU.
